system.description:
At 13th level, your hedge wizard can distill a fourth potion each long rest and to select from the following options. These effects are permanent unless broken by @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.ptdq0aw2indq5e6w]{Modify Memory} or @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.l16wg9h1z9s16exb]{Remove Curse}.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-adventuring-gear.Item.PeKHwGBNwCDXSqiG]{Forget}. When a creature drinks this potion, you may choose up to a one hour period of time to erase from the target’s memories. If the drinker is willing, they can instead erase the memory and ancillary memories of a specific event which lasted more than an hour, such as a death and their time mourning that passing or meeting a specific individual and falling in love.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-adventuring-gear.Item.X3xOwke4Hr74ww76]{Love}. When a creature drinks this potion, they must make a Charisma saving throw or fall in love with a target of your choosing within 60ft. The target may also be a drawing, painting, or illusion of a specific individual. They immediately become friendly with the chosen target and begin to pursue them in whatever manner is appropriate for their romantic and sexual preferences.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-adventuring-gear.Item.3SJDo5rQPh86z4JE]{Slumber}. A creature who drinks this potion falls into a torporous slumber for at least one hour and up to 20 years if they choose when they drink the potion. A creature in such a magical slumber cannot be awakened by traditional means, though Remove Curse and more powerful magics can awaken them, as can true love’s kiss. They do not hunger, thirst, or require air while in this state, but still cannot go into a bag of holding.
